# cascade severity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:cascadeSeverity`](gmeow-cascadeSeverity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/cascadeSeverity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The cascade's graded severity — according to whoever grades it (statement-layer indexed). NOT functional (review): grading is evaluative and source-variable; divergent grades coexist through the statement layer, and single-valuedness per base graph is SHACL's job (the [`hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) convention). Mandatory: an ungraded cascade is just a story.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Cascade`](../classes/gmeow-Cascade.md) -> [`gmeow:SeverityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-SeverityLevel.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:cascadeSeverity`](gmeow-cascadeSeverity.md) from [`gmeow:Cascade`](../classes/gmeow-Cascade.md) to [`gmeow:SeverityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-SeverityLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
